name: Tinker pets stay passive when the player picks Passive (#7475)
contract: #7475 reports Tinker pets treat Passive like Defensive: they keep attacking after the player sets Passive, above all after a re-summon or a relog. The pet AI (npc_ascension_tinker_pet) promoted every passive pet to defensive on its first update; a pet loaded from the database comes back with its saved Passive, so the player's choice was lost on every load. A level 80 Tinker builds a Mechano-Bear (803405), which must still spawn defensive (#4074): pet_react_state is 1. The player picks Passive with the native pet packet (pet_stance 0); while the Tinker attacks a dummy the pet must not take it as its victim. After a relog the pet must come back passive and still stay out of the fight. Picking Defensive again (pet_stance 1) must restore #4074: the pet takes the Tinker's target. The Tinker's own melee damages the dummy, so the pet's part is read from its victim, not from the dummy's health.
